reason: The inspected revision has a coherent Precision Instrument hierarchy and substantial accessibility improvements. findings.evidence: save() awaits authorizedFetch without a deadline (67-71), then can await an unbounded error body (73). pending only clears in finally (81-84), while the editing fieldset is disabled by pending (112). authorizedFetch in src/lib/client-fetch.ts:113-130 delegates directly to fetch. The rubric regression releases a delayed rejection; it does not cover a never-settling request.
findings.userImpact: An operator can remain at Saving with every rubric control disabled indefinitely; reloading risks losing the in-memory scoring guide and does not establish whether the write committed. This is a source-derived failure path, not a hosted reproduction.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the full request/body operation, retain the captured criteria, announce an unconfirmed outcome and restore a safe recovery path that checks the current saved rubric before retry. Add a stalled-request regression.
